# Salar Ahmed Mirza — Full Stack & AI Automation Engineer

> Full Stack and AI Automation Engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan. Specialises in React.js, FastAPI, Python, LangGraph, and production AI systems. Currently working at M3Hive building RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and intelligent chatbot systems.

## About

Salar Ahmed Mirza is a Software Engineer and AI Automation Engineer from Islamabad, Pakistan. His work spans React.js, FastAPI, Python, and AI orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI), with a strong focus on building scalable systems that solve real business problems.

He holds a BSSE (Bachelor of Software Engineering) and is currently working as an AI Backend Developer at M3Hive, where he builds production-grade RAG pipelines and LLM-powered systems.

Salar is open to work — available for remote and on-site opportunities.

## Current Role

- **Company:** M3Hive
- **Title:** AI Backend Developer
- **Duration:** November 2025 – Present
- **Focus:** RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, intelligent chatbot systems

## Projects

- **AI Lead Generator:** An AI-powered lead generation platform that transforms customer inquiries into qualified leads through conversational AI. Built with Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, OpenAI, PostgreSQL, Docker, WhatsApp Cloud API, and Redis. Uses multi-agent LangGraph workflows for lead qualification, context management, and meeting scheduling.

- **Nour Doc:** An AI-powered medical documentation assistant that records doctor-patient conversations, transcribes audio via Whisper, extracts clinically relevant information, and generates structured SOAP patient notes. Built with Python, FastAPI, OpenAI, Whisper, ChromaDB, and Docker.

- **AI CV Maker:** An AI-powered resume builder that generates professional, ATS-friendly resumes based on user experience, skills, and target job roles. Built with React.js, FastAPI, OpenAI API, PostgreSQL, and Python ReportLab for PDF export.

- **ScaffSmart ERP:** An Android ERP system for scaffolding businesses with inventory management, client management, and AI-powered material counting through YOLOv8 computer vision. Built with Kotlin, Python, Firebase, and YOLOv8.

- **Smart Weather:** A machine learning mobile app that predicts Air Quality Index (AQI) using weather data and location-based environmental parameters. Built with Flutter, Python, XGBoost, OpenWeather API, and Firebase.
